answer: Deter sybils with a random-audit inspection game, not by policing every seat. Each agent locks a bond; each epoch the protocol samples a few seats at random and hits them with an unforgeable work-and-liveness check, and any exposed clone forfeits its whole bond and is banned. Set audit odds p and penalty P so pP tops a seat's reward: p=5%, P=10,000 POA vs a 200 POA reward. An honest agent sits on its mesa of stake, rarely touched, but a farm vast as the ocean faces N audits, so 1,000 clones bleed 1,000*pP = 500,000 POA expected. Cheap to police, ruinous to fake: a deterrent tight as a sonnet.
